title: Crestline Fleet Account Disputes of Unapproved Over-Limit Tickets
content:
A business on a Crestline Fleet Account that pays an invoice but holds back the part of the ticket that went above its ticket approval limit without the fleet manager's approval contests that part by filing a dispute of an unapproved over-limit ticket on the invoice its most recent remittance was applied to. The rule on unapproved over-limit tickets fixes the amount that dispute carries.

## Effect of the filing

Filing registers one new open dispute on that invoice, carrying the disputed amount given, with the dispute reason recorded as an unauthorized purchase. Nothing on the invoice or on the account balance changes. Afterwards the dispute shows as open on the account's dispute list with its reference number.

## How the filing is made

The tool is `file_fleet_overlimit_dispute_8d937b85`. It is the business's own filing: the business's authorized fleet contact files it in person. The agent unlocks the tool and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fleet_account_id` | reference number of the business's fleet account, as shown by the fleet account lookup and read out by the agent | identifier text |
| `source_fleet_txn_id` | reference number of the fleet invoice being disputed, as shown by the fleet activity lookup and read out by the agent | identifier text |
| `disputed_amount` | the part of the invoice placed in dispute | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); recorded rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

The tool returns a text rendering of a receipt with these fields: `dispute_id` (reference number of the new dispute), `fleet_account_id` (the account disputed on), `invoice_id` (the invoice disputed), `reason` (always `unauthorized_purchase`), `disputed_amount` (USD with 2 decimal places, as recorded), `status` (always `open`) and `filed_at` (the moment the dispute was registered). A receipt whose status is `open` means the dispute was registered.

## Contract questions

- *Does the filing reduce what the business owes?* No; nothing on the invoice or the account balance changes when the dispute is registered.
- *How many disputes does one filing create?* One new open dispute on the invoice named.
